findings.rule: spec.md Requirements/Design: "verified_with (Claude Code version, plugin version, runner)"
findings.summary: All 32 `docs/notes/<N>.md` files carry `verified_with` as a single component (e.g. `"Claude Code 2.1.278"` or, here, just `"plugin 0.2.10"`) instead of the three spec.md calls for; only `docs/notes/25.md` combines two of the three, and none names a runner, so the environment-mismatch half of the staleness rule (choice 93) can't be checked from the field as populated.
